name: Transfer Magic Weapon Special Ability (Item Mastery)
body:
You can transfer a magic weapon special ability to a different weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Craft (weapons) 5 ranks, Use Magic Device 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Through an 8-hours meditative ritual, you can transfer one special ability from one magic weapon to another. The receiving weapon must be of masterwork quality or magical and suited for the transferred ability (for example, only a melee weapon can receive the mighty cleaving ability). The transfer is permanent.

The transference ritual requires expensive materials to complete. The cost of transferring a weapon special ability is 25% of the normal cost required to add the same ability to the receiving weapon.
